content: Indoor mapping platforms treat map authoring as the core admin job. Mappedin Map Editor / Map CMS and MazeMap Map Editor let a non-technical team ingest floor plans, place POIs, adjust styling, close areas and update routes and points of interest as buildings change, then publish; Mappedin states the requirement is that a room change can be published in minutes rather than weeks or vendor tickets. Academic sources confirm the manual authoring step: a Lund University student paper states that creation of a navigation graph is done by hand by placing individual nodes and connecting them using edges, and Fast Routing Graph Extraction from Floor Plans (2018) notes raster floor plans are simple to obtain but perform poorly for routing, motivating a separate navigation graph. Mappedin 9-step guide requires geo-referencing floor plan measurements to real-world dimensions; an LLM-floorplan-parsing paper confirms a scale factor converts floorplan measurements into real-world dimensions for distance estimation.
